result.topic_en: A table of eight parametric solutions (p, q, r, s in terms of a, b) paired as 'sociae' via generators p+q and p−q, followed by three numerical examples for (a,b) = (2,1), (3,2) and (1,1).
result.transcription:
226 L. EULERI OPERA POSTHUMA. Arithmetica.

| | $p$ | $q$ | $r$ | $s$ | |
I | $a+b$ | $2a-b$ | $a+b$ | $2b-a$ | $\alpha$
V | $2a+b$ | $b-a$ | $a+2b$ | $b-a$ | $\beta$
II | $b-2a$ | $6a$ | $2b-4a$ | $b+4a$ | $\gamma$
III | $b+2a$ | $6a$ | $2b+4a$ | $b-4a$ | $\delta$
$\alpha$ | $3a$ | $2b-a$ | $3b$ | $2a-b$ | 1
$\beta$ | $a+2b$ | $3a$ | $3b$ | $b+2a$ | 5
$\gamma$ | $b+4a$ | $b-8a$ | $3b$ | $8a-b$ | 2
$\delta$ | $b+8a$ | $b-4a$ | $3b$ | $8a+b$ | 3

Inter has octo solutiones quaelibet habet suam sociam, quae scilicet ex numeris genitoribus $p+q$ et $p-q$ nascitur, quas igitur paribus litteris graecis insignivimus.
EXEMPLUM 1. Sit $a=2$ et $b=1$, octo solutiones ita se habebunt:

| | $p$ | $q$ | $r$ | $s$
$\alpha$ | 3 | 3 | 3 | 0
$\alpha$ | 6 | 0 | 3 | 3
$\beta$ | 5 | 1 | 4 | 1
$\beta$ | 6 | 4 | 5 | 3
$\gamma$ | 12 | 3 | 9 | 6
$\gamma$ | 15 | 9 | 15 | 3
$\delta$ | 12 | 5 | 10 | 7
$\delta$ | 17 | 7 | 17 | 3

EXEMPLUM 2. Sit $a=3$ et $b=2$, et oriuntur solutiones in hac tabula expressae:

| | $p$ | $q$ | $r$ | $s$
$\alpha$ | 5 | 4 | 5 | 1
$\alpha$ | 9 | 1 | 6 | 4
$\beta$ | 8 | 1 | 7 | 1
$\beta$ | 9 | 7 | 8 | 6
$\gamma$ | $\left\{\begin{matrix}18\\9\end{matrix}\right.$ | $\begin{matrix}4\\2\end{matrix}$ | $\begin{matrix}14\\7\end{matrix}$ | $\left.\begin{matrix}8\\4\end{matrix}\right\}$
$\gamma$ | 11 | 7 | 11 | 3
$\delta$ | $\left\{\begin{matrix}18\\9\end{matrix}\right.$ | $\begin{matrix}8\\4\end{matrix}$ | $\begin{matrix}16\\8\end{matrix}$ | $\left.\begin{matrix}10\\5\end{matrix}\right\}$
$\delta$ | 13 | 5 | 13 | 3

EXEMPLUM 3. Si $a=1$ et $b=1$, sequentes oriuntur solutiones:

| | $p$ | $q$ | $r$ | $s$
$\alpha$ | 2 | 1 | 2 | 1
$\alpha$ | 3 | 1 | 3 | 1
$\beta$ | 3 | 0 | 3 | 0
$\beta$ | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3
$\gamma$ | 6 | 1 | 5 | 2
$\gamma$ | 7 | 5 | 7 | 3
$\delta$ | 6 | 3 | 6 | 3
$\delta$ | 9 | 3 | 9 | 3

methods.what: Eight parametric solutions for (p,q,r,s) in terms of two parameters a, b
Pairing of solutions: each solution has a companion obtained from the generators p+q and p−q
methods.quote: Inter has octo solutiones quaelibet habet suam sociam, quae scilicet ex numeris genitoribus $p+q$ et $p-q$ nascitur

methods.what: Numerical instance of the parametric solutions for a=2, b=1
methods.quote: Sit $a=2$ et $b=1$, octo solutiones ita se habebunt

methods.what: Numerical instance for a=3, b=2 (some solutions reduced by a common factor)
methods.quote: Sit $a=3$ et $b=2$, et oriuntur solutiones in hac tabula expressae

items.english: Among these eight solutions each one has its companion, namely the one that arises from the generating numbers p+q and p−q.
